title: 3D HD Versus 2D HD in Laparoscopic Inguinal Hernia Repair: a Randomized Controlled Trial
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to compare 3D-laparoscopy versus 2D-laparoscopy with the use of HD resolution in inguinal hernia repair in terms of error rating, performance time and subjective assessment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients scheduled for elective inguinal hernia repair (out-patient treatment)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous lower abdominal surgery
* ASA-score 3 or above
